basic_details.job_title: BRIC-NIAB Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 5 Scientist-D, Scientist-C Posts
basic_details.short_information: BRIC-National Institute of Animal Biotechnology (BRIC-NIAB), Hyderabad, an autonomous research institute under the Biotechnology Research and Innovation Council and funded by the Department of Biotechnology, Ministry of Science & Technology, has invited applications under Advertisement No. 31/2026 for five Scientist posts: one Scientist-D (Pay Level 12) and four Scientist-C (Pay Level 11), both as per the 7th CPC. Applications are made online at www.niab.res.in from 26 October 2026 to 30 November 2026, 5 PM, and the window is open as of 9 November 2026.

application_fee.details: The fee is paid by a crossed Demand Draft drawn on any nationalised bank, valid for at least 3 months, in favour of "National Institute of Animal Biotechnology, Hyderabad" payable at Hyderabad, preferably Punjab National Bank, Gachibowli (Code No. PUNB0498700), Hyderabad. The alternative is direct payment through https://epayments.in.worldline.com/niab. The notice also states that PWD/departmental candidates are exempted from the application fee.

how_to_apply: Go to the website www.niab.res.in; online applications are available from 26 October 2026.
Register with a username, password and valid email id. Already registered candidates may log in with their existing username and password.

Keep soft copies ready in PDF/JPEG format: recent passport size photograph, all educational certificates, all experience certificates, caste/category certificates, NOC from employer, and any other certificates or testimonials.
Pay the application fee by Demand Draft or through the payment link given above.

Upload self-attested copies of certificates, mark sheets and testimonials in support of age, educational qualifications, experience and caste (if applicable), along with the curriculum vitae and the fee payment receipt or DD copy (PDF format only), in the relevant part of the application format on or before the last date. The notice says a hard copy is not required.

If paying by Demand Draft, write the Advertisement Number, candidate's name, category and post applied for on the back of the draft. The notice asks for it to be sent in an envelope super-scribed "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF ________________" by post to the Director, National Institute of Animal Biotechnology, Sy.No. 37, Opp. Journalist Colony, Extended Q City Road, Gowlidoddi, Gachibowli, Hyderabad, Telangana, India 500 032.
Submit the application and keep the printout of the PDF for reference and record.
For technical queries while filling the application, the notice gives the email [email protected].
important_instructions: Government, Semi-Government, Autonomous Body and PSU employees should route their applications through proper channel. They may upload a No Objection Certificate, Vigilance Certificate and Integrity certificate at the time of online application and produce the original hard copy at interview, along with a certificate that no vigilance or disciplinary case is pending or contemplated. OBC candidates must belong to the Central List of OBCs and the Non Creamy Layer. The Non Creamy Layer certificate must be obtained on or after 01.04.2026. EWS candidates are those outside SC/ST/OBC (NCL) reservation whose family gross annual income is below ₹ 8.00 Lakh. The Income and Asset Certificate must be obtained on or after 01.04.2026 in the format of Annexure – III; certificates obtained before 01.04.2026 are not valid. SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD candidates must produce the latest certificate in the prescribed Government of India format at document verification for posts reserved for their category. A request to change category from General to a reserved one, or from one reserved category to another, will not be entertained. Canvassing in any form or bringing influence automatically disqualifies the candidate. Applications without signature, received after the due date and time, incomplete, or without fee payment will be summarily rejected. The Institute reserves the right to reject any or all applications and to cancel the advertised posts at any stage without assigning reasons. No interim enquiries about the recruitment will be entertained. The courts at Hyderabad, Telangana have jurisdiction over legal disputes.

rows.details: BRIC- National Institute of Animal Biotechnology
Department of Biotechnology, Ministry of Science & Technology, Government of India
Scientist-D: Pay Level 12; Scientist-C: Pay Level 11 (7th CPC)
₹ 1500/- for Unreserved and EWS/OBC candidates; NIL for SC/ST/Women/ESM/PwBD candidates

content_sections.heading: About BRIC-NIAB
content_sections.text: The National Institute of Animal Biotechnology (NIAB) is an autonomous research institute at Gachibowli, Hyderabad. According to the notice, it aims to harness novel and emerging biotechnologies for improving animal health and productivity. Its research focus is on animal genetics and genomics, transgenic technology, reproductive technology, diseases, nutritional enrichment and bioinformatics.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice offers 5 positions in total. The Scientist-D post is for Unreserved (UR) candidates. The four Scientist-C posts are divided as shown below.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Age is reckoned as on the closing date for receipt of applications. Age relaxation is as per Government of India guidelines and is granted only where the posts are reserved for the respective categories. For Persons with Benchmark Disabilities, age relaxation applies whether or not the post is reserved for them, provided the post is identified as suitable for the relevant category of disability. Essential: Ph.D. in any discipline of Life Sciences/Biotechnology/Biochemistry/Chemistry/Computational Biology/Pharmaceutical Sciences/Molecular Biology/Agricultural Sciences/Plant Sciences/related disciplines; or Ph.D. in Engineering or Technology in disciplines like Chemical/Biomedical/Pharmaceutical engineering or Doctor of Medicine (M.D.) in any branch of medicine/MDS/MVSc, from a recognised University or Institute or relevant areas of research. Experience: minimum three years of post-qualification experience in responsible higher position in research/teaching Institute/University/industry with published research of highest standards and/or technologies of established utility. Deputation/absorption: Scientists of the Central Govt/State Govt/Universities/Public Sector Undertakings or Government funded research organisations/institutes, subject to (a) possessing the qualification for direct recruits, and (b) either holding an analogous post on regular basis in the parent cadre, or having 5 years regular service in Level-11 in the relevant field. Essential: Ph.D. in any discipline of Life Sciences/Biotechnology/Biochemistry/Chemistry/Computational Biology/Pharmaceutical Sciences/Molecular Biology/Agricultural Sciences/Plant Sciences/related disciplines; or Ph.D. in Engineering or Technology in disciplines like Chemical/Biomedical/Pharmaceutical engineering or Doctor of Medicine (M.D.) in any branch of medicine/MDS/MVSc, from a recognised University or Institute or relevant areas of research. The notice states that experience for the position is reckoned from the date of acquiring the qualification prescribed for the position. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, refer to the official notification. The notice says applicants can apply in any one of the following research areas. Molecular Virology and Virus-Host Interactions: expertise in livestock and poultry viral pathogens, mechanisms of infection and host adaptation, and systems biology and multiomics approaches to viral disease research. Bacterial Pathogenesis and Antimicrobial Resistance: expertise in livestock and poultry bacterial pathogens, mechanisms of virulence, antimicrobial resistance, and functional genomics approaches to bacterial disease control. Precision Animal Nutrition and Nutritional Physiology: expertise in nutrient metabolism, feed utilisation, diet-microbiome interactions, and nutritional interventions to improve livestock and poultry health and productivity. Immunology and Vaccine Science: expertise in protective immune responses, antigen discovery, vaccine design

rows.method_of_recruitment: By Direct Recruitment failing which by Deputation (including short term contract)
rows.age_limit: Not exceeding 40 years for Direct recruitment; not exceeding 56 years on deputation (including short-term contract)

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Scientist-D is placed in Pay Level 12 and Scientist-C in Pay Level 11 as per the 7th CPC; the notice does not print rupee amounts. The posts carry the usual allowances admissible to Central Government employees of the same pay and status posted at Hyderabad, Telangana. Appointment is initially on probation for two years, which may be extended at the discretion of the Competent Authority. Further continuation depends on the candidate's performance during the probation period.

content_sections.heading: BRIC-NIAB Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice prints the same job description for both Scientist-D and Scientist-C: Work on production, reproduction and health aspects of livestock using modern tools of biotechnology. In addition to own research programme, provide support to other research projects at NIAB. Lead the HRD programme of the Institute. Attract extra-mural funding to establish and lead research programs. Any other duties assigned by the competent authority.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The fee is paid by a crossed Demand Draft drawn on any nationalised bank, valid for at least 3 months, in favour of "National Institute of Animal Biotechnology, Hyderabad" payable at Hyderabad, preferably Punjab National Bank, Gachibowli (Code No. PUNB0498700), Hyderabad. The alternative is direct payment through https://epayments.in.worldline.com/niab . The notice also states that PWD/departmental candidates are exempted from the application fee.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BRIC-NIAB Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: For technical queries while filling the application, the notice gives the email [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: If a large number of applications are received, screening will be done to limit the number of candidates to those possessing higher or relevant qualification and experience. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for interview. The Institute reserves the right to call only the requisite number of candidates after shortlisting, to convert desirable qualification into essential qualification, and to enhance the shortlisting criteria beyond the advertised qualification and experience. Candidates should therefore mention all qualifications and experience in the relevant area, supported with documents. Mere fulfilment of the minimum qualification and experience does not give any right to be called for interview. The notice does not mention the interview date or venue. Candidates called for interview are paid single second class rail fare from the actual place of journey or normal place of residence, whichever is nearer to Secunderabad Railway Station, on production of travel documents. Reservation and sleeper charges and superfast surcharge are admitted if the ticket or receipt is submitted.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in BRIC-NIAB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 5 positions: 1 Scientist-D (UR) and 4 Scientist-C (2 UR, 1 OBC and 1 EWS).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for BRIC-NIAB Scientist posts?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of online applications is 30-11-2026 by 5 PM. Online applications began on 26-10-2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for BRIC-NIAB Scientist-D and Scientist-C?
faq.answer: Both posts need a Ph.D. in a Life Sciences or related discipline, or a Ph.D. in Engineering or Technology (Chemical/Biomedical/Pharmaceutical engineering), or M.D./MDS/MVSc. Scientist-D also needs minimum three years of post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for BRIC-NIAB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Scientist-D: not exceeding 40 years for direct recruitment and not exceeding 56 years on deputation. Scientist-C: not exceeding 35 years. Age is reckoned as on the closing date for receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for BRIC-NIAB Scientist posts?
faq.answer: The fee is ₹ 1500/- for Unreserved and EWS/OBC candidates, for each post. SC/ST/Women/ESM/PwBD candidates pay NIL.

faq.question: Q6. How to apply for BRIC-NIAB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through www.niab.res.in after registering with a username, password and valid email id. Upload the required certificates and the fee receipt or DD copy before 30-11-2026, 5 PM.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for BRIC-NIAB Scientist posts?
faq.answer: Applications may be screened if many are received, and only shortlisted candidates are called for interview. The notice does not print an interview date.

faq.question: Q8. What is the pay for BRIC-NIAB Scientist-D and Scientist-C?
faq.answer: Scientist-D is in Pay Level 12 and Scientist-C in Pay Level 11 as per the 7th CPC, with the usual allowances admissible to Central Government employees posted at Hyderabad.

faq.question: Q9. Is there a probation period for BRIC-NIAB Scientist posts?
faq.answer: Yes. Appointment is initially on probation for two years, which may be extended at the discretion of the Competent Authority.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates apply for more than one research area?
faq.answer: No. The notice says applicants can apply in any one of the five listed research areas.
